title: approvals: an empty slate under `onEmptyApprovers: 'admin_rescue'` opens on the tenant's administrators as named approvers, not as a nameless rescue request (retires the #22725 `unstaffed` arm)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a task the maintainer dispatched directly.** The maintainer's words, verbatim, in the director chat on 2026-10-11:
- 「hotcrm#2057:新装的系统里,三类默认审批没人能批，这个应该是改平台的功能吧」
- 「作为一个工作流引擎，岗位没人时转给 owner 真的合理吗，有没有更好的方案」
- 「同意 P1」, approving route P1 below.

The ruling is recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057 (batch #316 item 2). Filed by the director seat, summon #36, `session_019fWAt2renophxLVg5aJXMH`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** triage first, for grade and lane, then the claimant.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` is the home, so `domain:services`.
- It touches `packages/spec` (the `onEmptyApprovers` description and the `IApprovalService` member this retires), `packages/rest` (the query parameter this retires) and `packages/lint` (one rule's message). Those go through the cross-domain exception path, as #22725 did, or as segments if triage splits them.
- ⛔ The direction is ruled. No seat files a decision card about it.

## The problem

When an approval node's slate resolves to no concrete person (an unstaffed position, an empty team, an unset manager), the default policy `admin_rescue` opens a request whose only "approver" is a `type:value` literal that names nobody. The `#3424` override then lets a platform or tenant admin act on it. That override was designed as break-glass. Its own docblock (`isOverrideActor`, `approval-service.ts`) says: "a stuck approval … admin may always act on a PENDING request to release it". Because the request names no one, every downstream feature needs a rescue arm of its own:
- the queue: #22725 added an `unstaffed` filter to `listRequests` / `countRequests` and the REST door (PR #22775, landed `c1b7f2b168`);
- the console's My Pending and bell: objectui#12102, open;
- the notification on open: none. The fan-out in `openNodeRequest` says a slate of literals "notifies nobody";
- reminders, delegation and push, if they are ever extended.

And a tenant admin's decision is recorded as an override, not as an approval.

Measured on HotCRM 4.0.1 with `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058 finding C-01, and the measurement on hotcrm#2057, `6101337518`). On every fresh install the default sign-offs route to unstaffed positions:
- the request is in nobody's My Pending;
- the bell reads 0;
- nobody is notified;
- a `lockRecord` deal stays locked until an admin thinks to open the All tab.

## The ruled change (P1)

**An empty slate under `admin_rescue` opens the request on a NAMED slate: the tenant's administrators.**
- The tenant's administrators are the people holding the tenant-admin rung of the request's organization: the same authority `isOverrideActor`'s tenant arm trusts (ADR-0095 D3, `ORGANIZATION_ADMIN_GRANTS`), resolved to users. ⛔ No second notion of "admin".
- Platform admins, who cross the tenant wall, are not put on the slate.
- Mainstream shape: SAP Business Workflow routes a work item with no agent to the workflow administrator; Feishu and DingTalk offer 「审批人为空时转交审批管理员」; Odoo gives an empty approval to an administrator; Entra has fallback approvers. In every one of them the person who receives the request is an ordinary approver in the ordinary inbox.

## Done when

1. **Open:** at node entry, a slate with no concrete person under `admin_rescue` (the default) opens on the tenant's administrators.
   - It is resolved through the same expansion as `approvers`, so OOO delegation and the notification fan-out apply unchanged.
   - The abandoned primary slate and the reason (for example, "position `sales_manager` has no holder") are kept in the request's `__resolvedFrom` snapshot, as the `fallback` branch already keeps them.
   - The request's display says it was routed to the administrators because the slate was empty.
2. **Ordinary paths only:**
   - the request is listed in each tenant admin's My Pending and counted in the bell through the normal `approverId` query;
   - each is told once on `approval.requested`;
   - a tenant admin's decision is a normal `decide`, recorded as an approval, not an override.
3. **Break-glass stays break-glass.** The #3424 override remains for two cases: a request whose named approvers have all left after it opened, and a tenant whose administrator slate itself resolves to nobody. In the second case the request opens as today's nameless request and the server logs it loudly.
4. **Retire the #22725 `unstaffed` arm.** Under the startup-stage rule, a parallel path is not kept beside its replacement. This covers:
   - the `IApprovalService.listRequests` / `countRequests` filter member;
   - the REST query parameter;
   - their pins.

   It follows the repository's retirement path for a `packages/spec` contract member (ADR-0087). No shipped consumer exists: objectui#12102 never built the console half. A census is still the claim's first step, and a real consumer goes back to the director seat.
5. **Protocol text:** the `onEmptyApprovers` description in `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` and `approvals.mdx` say that `admin_rescue` opens on the tenant's administrators. `fallback` stays as the way to name someone else.
6. **Lint:** the `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` message no longer says the request "waits forever". It says the request opens on the tenant's administrators, and suggests `fallback` to name the right person.
7. **Pins:**
   - a position-only slate with no holder opens on the tenant admins, is listed and counted for each, and notifies each;
   - a tenant admin's decision is an approval;
   - a member sees nothing;
   - a platform admin is not on the slate;
   - CONTROLS: a staffed slate is unchanged; `fallback`, `auto_approve` and `fail` are unchanged; a tenant with no administrator gets the nameless request plus the override.
8. **Siblings:** triage closes objectui#12102 as not planned, superseded by this card. objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057 is `pm:blocked` on this card. After the release, the hotcrm seat upgrades and re-measures a fresh install in a browser.

**Not in scope** (maintainer's ruling): a setup "health" page for positions with no holder.

**Workload:** one PR, about 400–700 lines, net of the retired arm.

## Duplicate check

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed:
- 「notify administrators when an admin_rescue approval request opens with no concrete approver」: 16 hits.
- 「approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty message waits forever admin rescue wording」: 18 hits.

None is this card. The nearest:
- #22725 (closed: the queue arm this retires);
- #22607 (closed: notification on open, concrete approvers only);
- #17931 (closed: `fallback` added);
- #22584 (closed: docs on empty slates);
- #21984 (closed: Setup's request view);
- objectui#12102 (open: the console arm this supersedes).

Dedupe words: `admin_rescue named slate tenant administrators` · `empty approver slate opens on admins` · `retire unstaffed arm`
